name: nerdtip
description: Cross-browser extension that highlights jargon and shows hover definitions.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('vendor', { recursive: true }); for (const f of ['browser-polyfill.js', 'browser-polyfill.js.map']) fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/webextension-polyfill/dist/' + f, 'vendor/' + f)"
